# Epic: Investments

**Slug:** investments
**Status:** draft
**Created:** 2026-10-13

## Goal

Stocks, funds, gold, crypto and commodities with lots, price history, user-chosen cost methods, virtual valuation and the realized and unrealized gain and loss reports.

## Scope

- Commodity accounts and lots
- Cost methods and adjustment entries
- Gain and loss reports
- Investment scenarios

## Out of Scope

- Auto price feeds (plugins later)
